label: Diagram 19
caption: Diagram 19 Protecting combustible material from uninsulated fluepipes for solid fuel appliances
description:
The drawing is headed "Diagram 19 Protecting combustible material from uninsulated fluepipes for solid fuel appliances". It shows an elevation on the left and a plan on the right, each in two forms, with and without a shield.

In the elevation, a fluepipe runs vertically, then diagonally, then vertically again, with stepped joints in the lower vertical section, with grey blocks either side. The top is dimensioned "At least 3 × D" and "D"; the diagonal section is marked "At least 3 × D"; the shield, a vertical black line on the right, projects below the fluepipe by "At least 1.5 × D", and the distance between the fluepipe and the shield is also dimensioned "At least 1.5 × D". Captions read "Elevation without shield" and "Elevation with shield".

In the plan, the fluepipe is a circle labelled "Fluepipe". The top is dimensioned "At least 3 × D", "D" and "At least 1.5 × D"; the vertical gaps between the circle and the ends of the shield are each "At least 1.5 × D". A note gives an air space of at least 12mm between non-combustible shield and combustible material. Captions read "Plan without shield" and "Plan with shield".

A grey swatch legend reads "Indicates combustible material". Below, text states shields should either a) extend beyond the fluepipe by at least 1.5 × D, or b) make any path between fluepipes and combustible material at least 3 × D long.
